newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Concord to float 25 pct of unit.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Concord to float 25 pct of unit.

text.p: Pacific Concord Holding Ltd plans to float 25 percent of its Concord Land Development Co Ltd unit, offering 300 million shares to raise a maximum HK$1.2 billion, market sources said on Thursday.

A preliminary listing document said about 85 percent of the offering, or 255 million shares, would be placed internationally and the remaining 15 percent would be offered in an initial public offering in Hong Kong, one analyst said.
He said according to the prospectus, an additional 45 million shares would be issued for over-allotment.

Concord Land, the Hong Kong and China property division of Pacific Concord, said on Monday it had set a preliminary price range of between HK$3.37 to HK$4.0 per share, representing a discount of 30-40 percent to net asset value (NAV).
Analysts said the prospectus showed adjusted total NAV was about HK$6.90 billion, or HK$5.75 per share.
The Hong Kong IPO is expected to start on October 29 and run to November 1, with trading in the shares tentatively set for November 7, one analyst said.
